move.description: Classify only the current customer message, using prior state solely to resolve short contextual replies. continue_by_chat and decline_call require an explicit channel preference or a refusal of a pending call offer; study goals and ordinary diagnostic replies are not channel choices. greeting is a current greeting or social opening. report_payment requires an explicit current-message claim that payment already happened; never use it for a greeting, a status question, a future intention, or merely because a link was sent earlier. ask_current_state is a question about what is already selected, sent, or recorded. provide_contact_details means the current message actually supplies identity details. select_course requires exactly one resolved canonical course_reference; use browse_catalog when you present several courses and ask the customer to choose. select_payment_plan records a chosen plan; request_payment_link requires an explicit request to receive or advance with the link. Map postponement expressions such as "lo voy a pensar", "tengo que pensarlo", "no ahora" and "no me quiero inscribir todavía" to defer_payment. decline_purchase requires an explicit definitive refusal to purchase; postponement is not a definitive refusal. unknown is only for meaning that remains unresolved after applying awaiting_reply.

secondary_moves.description: Additional distinct compatible intentions explicitly present in the current customer message. Never infer one and never include greeting or unknown.

vetoes.description: Include a veto only when the current customer message explicitly refuses that action: call, payment_link, or purchase. Otherwise return an empty array.

course_reference.description: Use null unless a course-scoped move applies. It is required whenever move or secondary_moves includes select_course: return the exact canonical code from catalog.available_offerings or catalog.candidate_offerings.

messages.description: One coherent reply split into one or two messages only. Answer the complete logical customer intervention before advancing once.

call_offer.description: Optional short and natural call invitation. Follow the call policy in the instructions; a natural question is allowed.

course_mentions.description: Declare the actual role of every named canonical course, including names in response.call_offer. Empty only when no course is named. Metadata never authorizes a course, gift or action; do not relabel a free benefit as an alternative or separate paid purchase.

offering_code.description: Exact canonical offering code from the authorized catalog.

confirmed_phone.description: The complete phone the customer confirms from the immediately previous assistant turn; otherwise null. Never infer a country code without customer confirmation.

profile_updates.description: Your interpretation of the customer's own contact data, with actual inbound source IDs and verbatim source quotes. Return an empty array when there is no supported update. A profile version is backend-owned and must never be generated.

source_message_id.description: An actual customer.contact_profile.sources id or current inbound message id; never a logical history-turn id.

source_quote.description: Verbatim source evidence. Prefer the exact value excerpt for set/correct; quote explicit retraction words for retract.

profile_requests.description: For each question collecting or clarifying contact data, identify the response.messages bubble and the fields it requests. Return an empty array when no data is requested.

customer_now.description: What the customer wants or doubts right now.

already_said.description: What you already said and must not repeat.

turn_reasoning.description: Internal short reasoning, filled before the reply. Never sent to the customer.

memory_candidates.description: Record your interpretation of explicit customer statements with a verbatim inbound source_quote. For a customer confirmation that price is the only barrier, use type constraint, key price_only_barrier, value confirmed; if the customer reports another barrier, use the same type/key with value other_barriers_reported. Omit this observation when unknown. For an explicit purchase decline use type objection, key purchase_decline. For an actual price objection use type objection, key price_objection. The source_quote must be verbatim customer text. These are recorded observations, not permissions or sales-step instructions.
